Name: Custom Gift Limits
Author: aedenthorn
Description:
By default, this mod sets the following gift limits per relationship type:

[list]
[*]Strangers (0 - 5 hearts) - 1 per day, 2 per week
[*]Friends (6 - 10 hearts) - 2 per day, 4 per week
[*]Lovers (dating) - 3 per day, 6 per week
[*]Spouses (married or roommate) - 4 per day, 8 per week
[/list]
You can set custom limits for each of the four types. If you set any value to -1 it will remove the limit entirely.

The mod also removes the gift checkboxes in the menu's social page, replacing them with two sets of numbers - the top set is [b]daily gifts / daily limit[/b] and the bottom set is [b]weekly gifts / weekly limit[/b].


[size=5][b]Technical[/b][/size]

Requires [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2400/]SMAPI[/url], uses Harmony.

Implements a [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]Generic Mod Config Menu[/url] interface to change config settings in-game.

Compatible with [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/6338]Mod Updater[/url]﻿ for automatic updates.
